title: See Every Block Once: Variance-Reduced Post-Training for Masked Diffusion Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.17754v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Policy gradient methods are widely used to align large language model outputs with human preferences, but the log-likelihoods they require cannot be directly computed in Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs). MDLM post-training therefore relies on a surrogate objective based on the Evidence Lower Bound (ELBO), and recent work estimates a blockwise variant of this objective via Monte Carlo methods to support blockwise generation. This introduces variance arising from block selection into the estimates. In this work, we propose a full-block estimator that evaluates every block exactly once and averages the results. translated_title: 每块只见一次：掩码扩散语言模型的方差缩减后训练
translated_abstract: 策略梯度方法被广泛用于使大语言模型的输出与人类偏好对齐，但其所需的对数似然在掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）中无法直接计算。因此，MDLM的后训练依赖于基于证据下界（ELBO）的代理目标，近期工作通过蒙特卡洛方法估计该目标的分块变体以支持分块生成。然而，现有的估计方案随机采样块索引，因此可能对同一个块进行多次评估，而某些块却未被评估，这给估计引入了源自块选择的方差。在本工作中，我们提出了一种全块估计器，它对每个块恰好评估一次并对结果取平均。我们在理论上证明，所提出的估计器在消除因块选择产生的组间方差的同时保持无偏，从而实现了更低的方差。
tldr: 提出一种全块估计器，通过对每个块恰好评估一次并取平均，在保持无偏的同时消除块选择带来的组间方差，从而显著降低掩码扩散语言模型后训练中的估计方差。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a full-block estimator that evaluates every block exactly once, remaining unbiased while eliminating block-selection variance, thereby reducing estimation variance in the post-training of masked diffusion language models.
